prompt_md: In a chess tournament, every player plays every other player exactly once, and 66 games are played in all. How many players are there?
prompt_short: Everyone plays everyone once, 66 games. How many players?
hint_md: Each player meets everyone except themselves.
explain_intuition_md: 11 is tempting because 1 + 2 + ... + 11 = 66. But with n players, each meets n - 1 others, so the total is 1 + 2 + ... + (n - 1). That reaches 66 when n is 12.
